checks: The production HTML animates before external scripts, styles and fonts download.
The startup animation remains until the production stylesheet is ready; a failed stylesheet does not hang startup.
The startup placeholder is replaced by the same text-free animation during identity recovery.
The login form replaces the animation after an unauthenticated response.
The initial catalog waits with an animation rather than showing a premature empty library.
Reduced motion uses the static book; desktop and phone remain centered without overflow.
